critical_finding: Code inspection revealed that the X1 estimate of 20-30 Lane 1 routes may have been inflated. Many routes that appeared simple based on pattern analysis actually either (1) already use withCanonicalEnforcement (from prior G6T/G6U/G7 migrations), (2) require capabilities (making them Lane 2), or (3) have complex auth patterns (Lane 7-9). True Lane 1 routes (GET-only, NO capability, simple auth) appear to be significantly fewer than estimated.
recommendation: DEFER LANE_1 EXECUTION. Instead, recalibrate X1 migration matrix estimates. After LANE_2 completion, re-audit remaining violations to identify true LANE_1 routes.
